trackerDiscrepancy.explanation: The tracker reports 145 open chapter quarantines, while direct enumeration yields 147 open chapter-level instances under 134 distinct source IDs. Phase 7.2 preserves every chapter-level instance and does not alter the frozen Phase 7.1C tracker.

migrationKeyRule: Use {chapter}:{sourceId} as the unique Phase 7.2 migration key while retaining sourceId as provenance.
identityRule: Every chapter-level contradiction or quarantine instance is retained. Repeated source IDs are not collapsed, and no source instance is deleted or promoted into geometry.
countingRule: Direct enumeration controls the migration: 147 chapter-level instances, 134 distinct source IDs and 13 repeated-ID instances. The tracker value remains preserved as legacy metadata only.

defaultGraphState.resolutionPolicy: A quarantine may be superseded only by an explicit later record that cites its composite migration key and independent evidence.

classificationRules.graphEffect: Do not create adjacency or route edges.
Keep as time-state metadata; do not create permanent architecture.

fallbackClass.graphEffect: Carry forward unchanged with navigation and geometry prohibited.
